summary.text: Joe Rafferty is a Democratic member of the Maine Senate for Senate District 34, which covers Berwick, Cape Porpoise, Kennebunk, Kennebunkport, North Berwick and Wells in York County.
The Senate page lists Joe Rafferty as chair of the Education and Cultural Affairs committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Senate service in the 130th through 132nd Legislatures.
Committee assignments listed: Education and Cultural Affairs (chair); Labor.
